overview.short: Kapileshwar Temple in Madhubani is an ancient Shiva temple established by Sage Kapila (founder of Samkhya philosophy), situated in the epicenter of world-famous Mithila art.
overview.description: Located in Rahika block near Madhubani, Kapileshwar Sthan is one of Mithila’s most revered Shaivite pilgrimage shrines. Surrounded by sacred lotus ponds, historic mango orchards, and the vibrant Mithila painting villages of Jitwarpur and Ranti, the temple hosts massive gatherings during Shravan and Maha Shivratri.
features: Swayambhu Shiva Lingam Established by Sage Kapila
Ancient Mithila Painting Artisan Villages (Jitwarpur & Ranti)
overview.about: A culturally vibrant pilgrimage haven where Vedic philosophy, sacred Shiva waters, and UNESCO-recognized Madhubani folk paintings flourish.

howToReach.roadNote: Located 8 km from Madhubani town, accessible via NH-527B and SH-50 from Darbhanga.
